title: Pattaya, Bangkok & Phuket Holiday
shortDescription: Three faces of Thailand in one week. Start on the beaches of Phuket with a half-day city tour, then fly to Bangkok and transfer to Pattaya for a coral island trip and easy beach days.
description: Three faces of Thailand in one week. Start on the beaches of Phuket with a half-day city tour, then fly to Bangkok and transfer to Pattaya for a coral island trip and easy beach days.
End in Bangkok with the city's temples, gem galleries and street food, with return economy airfare from Delhi on Thai Airways included.

hero.alt: A tropical bay in Phuket seen from the hillside

highlights: 2 nights each in Phuket, Pattaya and Bangkok

itinerary.title: Delhi – Bangkok – Phuket
itinerary.description: Arrive Bangkok after clearing custom, visa processing, baggage claim take a connecting flight to Phuket. On arrival you will be met and transferred to your hotel Overnight stay at Hotel.

itinerary.title: Phuket
itinerary.description: Breakfast in the hotel (7 A.M. to 9 A.M). After breakfast you will be taken on a half day city of Phuket Evening is at leisure. Overnight at the Hotel.

itinerary.title: Phuket – Bangkok – Pattaya
itinerary.description: Breakfast in the hotel (7 A.M. to 9 A.M). After breakfast take a flight to Bangkok, arrive Bangkok airport, met and transfer to Pattaya hotel, Day free at Leisure. Overnight stay at Hotel.

itinerary.title: Pattaya
itinerary.description: Breakfast in the hotel (7 A.M. to 9 A.M). After breakfast, proceed for half day coral island tour. Day free at leisure. Overnight at the Hotel.

itinerary.title: Pattaya – Bangkok
itinerary.description: Breakfast in the hotel (7 A.M. to 9 A.M). After breakfast check out from the hotel for Bangkok and visit to World Gems Collection show room.. Check in the Bangkok hotel. Overnight at hotel.

itinerary.title: Bangkok
itinerary.description: Breakfast in the hotel (7 A.M. to 9 A.M). Day free at leisure. Overnight at hotel.

itinerary.title: Bangkok – Delhi
itinerary.description: Breakfast in the hotel (7 A.M. to 9 A.M) Check out from the hotel for the city tour (Max 3 hrs). After city tour Transferred to the airport and get transfer to Airport to catch your flight back to Delhi.

inclusions: Economy Class return Airfare on Thai Airways (Note: Airfare Subject to availability)
Airport Hotel return transfers on Seat-In-Coach basis
Coral Island tour at Pattaya on Seat-In-Coach basis
Half Day city tour at Bangkok on Seat-In-Coach basis
Half Day city tour at Phuket on Seat-In-Coach basis
All hotel taxes and service charges
exclusions: Any Services not mentioned in the Inclusions
Travel Insurance (Strongly recommended for Senior Citizens)
Any expenses of personal nature such as tips to drivers, guides, representative laundry expenses, wines, mineral water, food and drinks not in the regular menus provided by us
On Arrival Visa fee of 2000 Thai baht (to be Paid directly by the Guest at Thailand airport) OR Visa fee from India Rs. 4,000/- (per person) Extra
